documentChecklist.title: Required Underwriting Vault Items
documentChecklist.subtitle: Provide these core items to receive binding term options within 3 business hours.

items.name: 6 Months Business Bank Statements
items.description: Full transactional PDF downloads containing all pages. No screenshots.

items.name: 2 Years Business Tax Returns
items.description: Signed federal tax returns including all schedules and K1s if applicable.

items.name: 3 Months Merchant Processing Statements
items.description: Only required for retail/e-commerce operations with card-heavy merchant setups.

items.name: Active Business Debt Schedule
items.description: Simple ledger highlighting any existing SBA positions, MCA loans, or credit lines.
